about.title: Product-minded frontend engineering
about.profile: Software engineer with a strong frontend background and experience shipping digital products end-to-end. My work spans requirements, product design, frontend architecture, backend collaboration, automation, and production delivery — combining engineering craft with product thinking and AI-assisted development.
achievements: Led technical direction for multiple product initiatives in rapidly changing environments
Defined frontend architecture and reusable standards adopted across projects
Designed end-to-end solutions from discovery and UX/UI to production
Acted as the technical reference for complex frontend and architecture decisions
Introduced AI-assisted development workflows that improved team productivity
Streamlined delivery with CI/CD improvements and automation
